definition: Acting or done quickly and without thought or care.

definitionEnglish: implied though not plainly expressed; with no qualification or question; absolute.

definitionEnglish: collapse or cause to collapse violently inward.

definitionEnglish: (of a fortified position) unable to be captured or broken into.

definitionEnglish: a person who organizes and often finances concerts, plays, or operas.

definitionEnglish: emitting light as a result of being heated; full of strong emotion; passionate.

definitionEnglish: a thing that motivates or encourages one to do something.

definitionEnglish: a person who becomes involved in a place or situation where they are not wanted or are considered not to belong.
exampleEnglish: She felt like an interloper in their private conversation.
exampleKurdish: هەستی دەکرد وەک کەسێکی بێگانە و دەستوەردەرە لە گفتوگۆ تایبەتەکەیاندا.

meaning: ناوەندگیر، کەسێک کە لە نێوان دوو لایەندا کار دەکات
definition: A person who acts as a link between people in order to try to bring about an agreement or reconciliation; a mediator.
definitionEnglish: a person who acts as a link between people in order to try to bring about an agreement or reconciliation; a mediator.
exampleEnglish: He acted as an intermediary in the negotiations.
exampleKurdish: وەک ناوەندگیرێک لە دانوستانەکاندا کاری کرد.

meaning: بێ کۆتایی، زۆر درێژ و بێزارکەر
definition: Endless (often used hyperbolically).
definitionEnglish: endless (often used hyperbolically).
exampleKurdish: کۆبوونەوەکە بێ کۆتایی و زۆر درێژ بوو.

definition: Occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous or steady.
definitionEnglish: occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous or steady.
exampleEnglish: The rain was intermittent throughout the day.
exampleKurdish: بارانەکە بە درێژایی ڕۆژەکە پچڕپچڕ بوو.

meaning: شەڕی ناوخۆیی زیانبەخش بۆ هەردوو لایەن
definition: Destructive to both sides in a conflict.
definitionEnglish: destructive to both sides in a conflict.
exampleEnglish: The party was weakened by internecine fighting.
exampleKurdish: پارتەکە بەهۆی شەڕی ناوخۆییەوە لاواز بوو.

meaning: زیادکردنی شتێک بۆ ناو دەقێک یان زنجیرەیەک
definition: Insert (something) between fixed points.
definitionEnglish: insert (something) between fixed points.
exampleEnglish: He interpolated a few words of his own into the speech.
exampleKurdish: چەند وشەیەکی خۆی خستە ناو وتارەکەوە.

meaning: ماوەی نێوان دوو دەسەڵاتدار یان حکومەت
definition: A period when normal government is suspended, especially between successive reigns or regimes.
definitionEnglish: a period when normal government is suspended, especially between successive reigns or regimes.
exampleEnglish: The country went through a brief interregnum.
exampleKurdish: وڵاتەکە بە ماوەیەکی کورتی نێوان دوو دەسەڵاتدا تێپەڕی.

definition: Ask questions of (someone, especially a suspect or a prisoner) closely, aggressively, or formally.
definitionEnglish: ask questions of (someone, especially a suspect or a prisoner) closely, aggressively, or formally.
exampleEnglish: The police interrogated the suspect for hours.
exampleKurdish: پۆلیس بۆ ماوەی چەند کاتژمێرێک لێکۆڵینەوەیان لەگەڵ گومانلێکراوەکە کرد.

meaning: بڵاوکردنەوەی شتێک لە ناو شتێکی تردا
definition: Scatter among or between other things.
definitionEnglish: scatter among or between other things.
exampleEnglish: The grass was interspersed with wildflowers.
exampleKurdish: گیاکە بە گوڵی کێوی دەورە درابوو (گوڵی تێدا بڵاو ببووەوە).

definition: Existing or carried on between states.
definitionEnglish: existing or carried on between states.

definition: An intervening space, especially a very small one.
definitionEnglish: an intervening space, especially a very small one.
exampleEnglish: Sunshine filtered through the interstices of the leaves.
exampleKurdish: تیشکی خۆر لە درزی گەڵاکانەوە دەهاتە ژوورەوە.

meaning: دەستوەردان (بۆ چاککردنی بارودۆخێک)، ڕوودان لە نێوان دوو کاتدا
definition: Come between so as to prevent or alter a result or course of events.
definitionEnglish: come between so as to prevent or alter a result or course of events.
exampleEnglish: The government decided to intervene in the strike.
exampleKurdish: حکومەت بڕیاری دا دەستوەردان بکات لە مانگرتنەکەدا.

definition: Closely acquainted; familiar, close; state or make known; hint.
definitionEnglish: closely acquainted; familiar, close; state or make known; hint.

definition: Frighten or overawe (someone), especially in order to make them do what one wants.
definitionEnglish: frighten or overawe (someone), especially in order to make them do what one wants.
exampleEnglish: They tried to intimidate the witnesses.

meaning: سەخت، شتێک کە ناتوانرێت بە ئاسانی کۆنترۆڵ بکرێت
definition: Hard to control or deal with.
definitionEnglish: hard to control or deal with.
exampleEnglish: The problem proved to be intractable.
exampleKurdish: کێشەکە دەرکەوت کە زۆر سەختە (کۆنترۆڵ ناکرێت).

meaning: کەلەڕەق، کەسێک کە ئامادە نییە بۆچوونی بگۆڕێت
definition: Unwilling or refusing to change one's views or to agree about something.
definitionEnglish: unwilling or refusing to change one's views or to agree about something.
exampleKurdish: حکومەت بە کەلەڕەقی مایەوە (ئامادە نەبوو بێتە سەر خەت).

definition: Fearless; adventurous.
definitionEnglish: fearless; adventurous.

meaning: بنەڕەتی، شتێک کە لە ناو خودی شتەکەدایە
definition: Belonging naturally; essential.
definitionEnglish: belonging naturally; essential.
exampleEnglish: The intrinsic value of the diamond.

meaning: وردبوونەوە لە خود، لێکۆڵینەوە لە هەستەکانی خۆت
definition: Characterized by examination of one's own thoughts and feelings.
definitionEnglish: characterized by examination of one's own thoughts and feelings.
exampleEnglish: He is a quiet, introspective person.
exampleKurdish: ئەو کەسێکی بێدەنگ و وردە لە هەستەکانی خۆی.

meaning: گۆشەگیر، کەسێک کە حەز بە تەنهایی دەکات
definition: A shy, reticent person.
definitionEnglish: a shy, reticent person.
exampleEnglish: He is an introvert who prefers reading to socializing.
exampleKurdish: ئەو کەسێکی گۆشەگیرە و خوێندنەوەی لە تێکەڵبوونی خەڵک پێ باشترە.

meaning: دەستوەردان، چوونە ناو شوێنێک بەبێ مۆڵەت
definition: Put oneself into a place or situation where one is unwelcome or uninvited.
definitionEnglish: put oneself into a place or situation where one is unwelcome or uninvited.
exampleEnglish: I'm sorry to intrude on your privacy.
exampleKurdish: ببورە کە دەستوەردەدەمە ناو ژیانی تایبەتیتەوە.

definition: The ability to understand something immediately, without the need for conscious reasoning.
definitionEnglish: the ability to understand something immediately, without the need for conscious reasoning.
exampleEnglish: Intuition told me that something was wrong.
exampleKurdish: هەستی ناوەکیم پێی وتم کە شتێک هەڵەیە.

definition: Overwhelm (someone) with things or people to be dealt with; flood.
definitionEnglish: overwhelm (someone) with things or people to be dealt with; flood.
exampleKurdish: بە لێشاو سکاڵامان بۆ هات (پڕ بووین لە سکاڵا).

definition: Accustom (someone) to something, especially something unpleasant.
definitionEnglish: accustom (someone) to something, especially something unpleasant.
exampleEnglish: They were inured to the cold.

meaning: هەڵوەشاندنەوە، بێ بایەخکردن (بەتایبەت یاسا یان بەڵگە)
definition: Make (an argument, statement, or theory) unsound or erroneous; deprive (an official document or procedure) of legal efficacy because of contravention of a regulation or law.
definitionEnglish: make (an argument, statement, or theory) unsound or erroneous; deprive (an official document or procedure) of legal efficacy because of contravention of a regulation or law.
exampleEnglish: The new evidence invalidates his theory.
exampleKurdish: بەڵگە نوێیەکە تیۆرییەکەی ئەو هەڵدەوەشێنێتەوە (بێ بایەخی دەکات).

definition: Insulting, abusive, or highly critical language.
definitionEnglish: insulting, abusive, or highly critical language.
exampleEnglish: He let out a stream of invective.
exampleKurdish: دەستی کرد بە وتنی کۆمەڵێک قسەی توند و سووکایەتی.

definition: Speak or write about (something) with great hostility.
definitionEnglish: speak or write about (something) with great hostility.
exampleEnglish: He inveighed against the government's policies.
exampleKurdish: بە توندی ڕەخنەی لە سیاسەتەکانی حکومەت گرت.

meaning: هەڵخەڵەتاندن بە قسەی خۆش بۆ کردنی کارێک
definition: Persuade (someone) to do something by means of deception or flattery.
definitionEnglish: persuade (someone) to do something by means of deception or flattery.
exampleEnglish: He inveigled her into giving him the money.
exampleKurdish: بە قسەی خۆش هەڵیخەڵەتاند بۆ ئەوەی پارەکەی پێ بدات.

definition: Opposite in position, direction, order, or effect.
definitionEnglish: opposite in position, direction, order, or effect.
exampleEnglish: There is an inverse relationship between price and demand.
exampleKurdish: پەیوەندییەکی پێچەوانە لە نێوان نرخ و خواستدا هەیە.

definition: Put upside down or in the opposite position, order, or arrangement.
definitionEnglish: put upside down or in the opposite position, order, or arrangement.
exampleEnglish: Invert the cake onto a cooling rack.
exampleKurdish: کێکەکە سەراوژێر بکە سەر ڕەفەی ساردکەرەوە.

meaning: ڕاهاتوو، شتێک کە بووەتە خوو (بەتایبەت خووی خراپ)
definition: Having a particular habit, activity, or interest that is long-established and unlikely to change.
definitionEnglish: having a particular habit, activity, or interest that is long-established and unlikely to change.

meaning: ناخۆش، شتێک کە دەبێتە هۆی تووڕەیی یان ئیرەیی
definition: (Of an action or situation) likely to arouse or incur resentment or anger in others.
definitionEnglish: (of an action or situation) likely to arouse or incur resentment or anger in others.
exampleKurdish: کارێکی ناخۆش و بێزارکەر بوو (کە دەبێتە هۆی تووڕەیی).

definition: Give strength or energy to.
definitionEnglish: give strength or energy to.
exampleKurdish: ئاوە ساردەکە وزە و هێزی پێ بەخشی.

meaning: تێکنەشکاو، شتێک کە ناتوانرێت شکست پێ بهێنرێت
definition: Too powerful to be defeated or overcome.
definitionEnglish: too powerful to be defeated or overcome.

meaning: پیرۆز، شتێک کە ناتوانرێت پێشێل بکرێت
definition: Never to be broken, infringed, or dishonored.
definitionEnglish: never to be broken, infringed, or dishonored.
exampleEnglish: The right to life is inviolable.
exampleKurdish: مافی ژیان پیرۆزە و ناتوانرێت پێشێل بکرێت.

meaning: داوای یارمەتی (بەتایبەت لە خودا)، بەکارهێنانی یاسا
definition: The action of invoking something or someone for assistance or as an authority.
definitionEnglish: the action of invoking something or someone for assistance or as an authority.

meaning: پەنابردنە بەر (یاسا یان خودا)، هێنانە پێشەوەی هەستێک
definition: Cite or appeal to (someone or something) as an authority for an action or in support of an argument; call on (a deity or spirit) in prayer, as a witness, or for inspiration.
definitionEnglish: cite or appeal to (someone or something) as an authority for an action or in support of an argument; call on (a deity or spirit) in prayer, as a witness, or for inspiration.
exampleEnglish: The police can invoke special powers in an emergency.
exampleKurdish: پۆلیس دەتوانێت پەنا بەرێتە بەر (بەکاری بهێنێت) دەسەڵاتە تایبەتەکان لە کاتی فریاکەوتندا.

meaning: پارێزراو، شتێک کە ناتوانرێت زیانی پێ بگەیەنرێت
definition: Impossible to harm or damage.
definitionEnglish: impossible to harm or damage.
exampleEnglish: The fortress was invulnerable to attack.
exampleKurdish: قەڵاکە پارێزراو بوو لە هێرش (نەدەتوانرا زیانی پێ بگەیەنرێت).

definition: An extremely small amount.
definitionEnglish: an extremely small amount.
exampleEnglish: There is not an iota of truth in his story.

meaning: زوو تووڕە، کەسێک کە بە ئاسانی تووڕە دەبێت
definition: Having or showing a tendency to be easily angered.
definitionEnglish: having or showing a tendency to be easily angered.
exampleEnglish: He is an irascible old man.
exampleKurdish: ئەو پیاوێکی پیر و زوو تووڕەیە.

definition: Feeling or characterized by great anger.
definitionEnglish: feeling or characterized by great anger.
exampleEnglish: We received an irate letter from a customer.
exampleKurdish: نامەیەکی زۆر تووڕەمان لە کڕیارێکەوە پێگەیشت.

meaning: ڕەنگاوڕەنگ، درەوشاوە بە ڕەنگی جیاواز (وەک پەڵەی نەوت لەسەر ئاو)
definition: Showing luminous colors that seem to change when seen from different angles.
definitionEnglish: showing luminous colors that seem to change when seen from different angles.
exampleEnglish: The iridescent feathers of the peacock.

definition: Irritating; annoying.
definitionEnglish: irritating; annoying.

definition: Using or characterized by irony; happening in the opposite way to what is expected, and typically causing wry amusement because of this.
definitionEnglish: using or characterized by irony; happening in the opposite way to what is expected, and typically causing wry amusement because of this.
exampleEnglish: It's ironic that the computer repairman's own computer is broken.
exampleKurdish: تەنزئامێزە (سەیرە) کە کۆمپیوتەری خودی چاککەرەوەی کۆمپیوتەرەکە تێکچووە.

definition: The expression of one's meaning by using language that normally signifies the opposite, typically for humorous or emphatic effect; a state of affairs or an event that seems deliberately contrary to what one expects and is often amusing as a result.
definitionEnglish: the expression of one's meaning by using language that normally signifies the opposite, typically for humorous or emphatic effect; a state of affairs or an event that seems deliberately contrary to what one expects and is often amusing as a result.
exampleEnglish: The irony is that he failed the exam he studied hardest for.
exampleKurdish: تەنزەکە لەوەدایە کە لەو تاقیکردنەوەیەدا دەرنەچوو کە زۆرترین خوێندنی بۆ کردبوو.

definition: Expose to radiation; illuminate (something) as if by shining light on it.
definitionEnglish: expose to radiation; illuminate (something) as if by shining light on it.

meaning: ئاشت نەکراوە، جیاوازییەک کە ناتوانرێت چارەسەر بکرێت
definition: (Of ideas, facts, or statements) representing findings or points of view that are so different from each other that they cannot be made compatible.
definitionEnglish: (of ideas, facts, or statements) representing findings or points of view that are so different from each other that they cannot be made compatible.

meaning: ڕەتنەکراوە، شتێک کە ناتوانرێت بسەلمێنرێت کە هەڵەیە
definition: Impossible to deny or disprove.
definitionEnglish: impossible to deny or disprove.

meaning: بێ پەیوەندی، شتێک کە پەیوەندی بە بابەتەکەوە نییە
definition: Not connected with or relevant to something.
definitionEnglish: not connected with or relevant to something.
exampleEnglish: His comment was irrelevant to the discussion.
exampleKurdish: تێبینییەکەی (قسەکەی) بێ پەیوەندی بوو بە گفتوگۆکەوە.

meaning: چارەسەر نەکراو، شتێک کە ناتوانرێت چاک بکرێتەوە
definition: Impossible to cure or put right.
definitionEnglish: impossible to cure or put right.
exampleKurdish: زیانەکە چارەسەر نەکراو بوو (نەدەتوانرا چاک بکرێتەوە).

meaning: چاکنەکراوە، زیانێک کە ناتوانرێت قەرەبوو بکرێتەوە
definition: (Of injury or loss) impossible to rectify or repair.
definitionEnglish: (of injury or loss) impossible to rectify or repair.
exampleEnglish: The fire caused irreparable damage to the building.
exampleKurdish: ئاگرەکە زیانێکی چاکنەکراوەی گەیاند بە بیناکە.

definition: Not able to be controlled or restrained.
definitionEnglish: not able to be controlled or restrained.
exampleEnglish: She has an irrepressible sense of humor.

meaning: بێ کەموکوڕی، کەسێک کە ناتوانرێت ڕەخنەی لێ بگریت
definition: Beyond criticism; faultless.
definitionEnglish: beyond criticism; faultless.
exampleKurdish: هەڵسوکەوتی بێ کەموکوڕی بوو (نەدەتوانرا ڕەخنەی لێ بگریت).

definition: Showing or feeling hesitancy; uncertain.
definitionEnglish: showing or feeling hesitancy; uncertain.
exampleEnglish: He stood irresolute at the door.

meaning: نەگەڕاوە، شتێک کە ناتوانرێت دووبارە بەدەست بهێنرێتەوە
definition: Not able to be retrieved or put right.
definitionEnglish: not able to be retrieved or put right.
exampleEnglish: The loss of the data was irretrievable.
exampleKurdish: لەدەستدانی زانیارییەکان نەگەڕاوە بوو (نەدەتوانرا بەدەست بهێنرێتەوە).

meaning: بێڕێزی بەرامبەر شتە پیرۆزەکان یان گرنگەکان
definition: A lack of respect for people or things that are generally taken seriously.
definitionEnglish: a lack of respect for people or things that are generally taken seriously.
exampleEnglish: The book is full of irreverence.
exampleKurdish: کتێبەکە پڕە لە بێڕێزی (بەرامبەر شتە باوەکان).

definition: Not able to be changed, reversed, or recovered; final.
definitionEnglish: not able to be changed, reversed, or recovered; final.

definition: Each of two or more forms of the same element that contain equal numbers of protons but different numbers of neutrons in their nuclei.
definitionEnglish: each of two or more forms of the same element that contain equal numbers of protons but different numbers of neutrons in their nuclei.

meaning: بەرزەخ، زەوییەکی باریک کە دوو وشکانی گەورە بەیەکەوە دەبەستێتەوە
definition: A narrow strip of land with sea on either side, forming a link between two larger areas of land.
definitionEnglish: a narrow strip of land with sea on either side, forming a link between two larger areas of land.

meaning: گەڕۆک، کەسێک کە بۆ کار لە شوێنێکەوە بۆ شوێنێکی تر دەچێت
definition: Traveling from place to place.
definitionEnglish: traveling from place to place.

definition: A planned route or journey.
definitionEnglish: a planned route or journey.
exampleEnglish: We have a very busy itinerary.

definition: Talk rapidly and excitedly but with little sense.
definitionEnglish: talk rapidly and excitedly but with little sense.
exampleEnglish: He was jabbering away on his phone.
exampleKurdish: بە خێرایی و ناڕوونی لەسەر مۆبایلەکەی قسەی دەکرد.

meaning: ماندوو و بێزار (بەهۆی زۆری کار یان چێژ)
definition: Tired, bored, or lacking enthusiasm, typically after having had too much of something.
definitionEnglish: tired, bored, or lacking enthusiasm, typically after having had too much of something.
exampleEnglish: He felt jaded after the long flight.
exampleKurdish: هەستی بە ماندوێتی و بێزاری دەکرد دوای گەشتە درێژەکە.

definition: Special words or expressions that are used by a particular profession or group and are difficult for others to understand.
definitionEnglish: special words or expressions that are used by a particular profession or group and are difficult for others to understand.
exampleEnglish: Legal jargon can be difficult to understand.
exampleKurdish: زاراوە یاساییەکان دەکرێت تێگەیشتنیان ئەستەم بێت.

definition: A medical condition with yellowing of the skin or whites of the eyes; a state of feeling resentment or cynicism.
definitionEnglish: a medical condition with yellowing of the skin or whites of the eyes; a state of feeling resentment or cynicism.
exampleEnglish: He looked at the proposal with a jaundiced eye.
exampleKurdish: بە نیگایەکی نەرێنی و گوماناوییەوە سەیری پێشنیارەکەی کرد.

definition: A short excursion or journey for pleasure.
definitionEnglish: a short excursion or journey for pleasure.
exampleEnglish: They went on a jaunt to the seaside.
exampleKurdish: گەشتێکی کورتیان کرد بۆ کەنار دەریا.

definition: Having or expressing a lively, cheerful, and self-confident manner.
definitionEnglish: having or expressing a lively, cheerful, and self-confident manner.
exampleEnglish: He walked with a jaunty step.
exampleKurdish: بە هەنگاوێکی دڵخۆشانە و پڕ متمانەوە دەڕۆیشت.

definitionEnglish: put (someone or something) into a situation in which there is a danger of loss, harm, or failure.

exampleKurdish: کەشوهەوای خراپ دەکرێت هەموو پڕۆژەکە بخاتە مەترسییەوە.

meaning: فڕێدانی شتێک (بەتایبەت لە کەشتی یان فڕۆکە بۆ سووککردنی بار)، وازهێنان لە بیرۆکەیەک
definition: Throw or drop (something) from an aircraft or ship; abandon or discard (someone or something that is no longer wanted).
definitionEnglish: throw or drop (something) from an aircraft or ship; abandon or discard (someone or something that is no longer wanted).

exampleKurdish: کاپتنەکە بڕیاری دا هەندێک لە بارەکە فڕێ بدات (بۆ سووککردنی کەشتییەکە).

definition: Extreme patriotism, especially in the form of aggressive or warlike foreign policy.
definitionEnglish: extreme patriotism, especially in the form of aggressive or warlike foreign policy.
exampleEnglish: The country was swept by a wave of jingoism.
exampleKurdish: وڵاتەکە لێشاوێکی نەتەوەپەرستی توند و شەڕخوازانە دایپۆشی.

definition: Playful or humorous.
definitionEnglish: playful or humorous.
exampleEnglish: He was in a jocose mood.
exampleKurdish: لە مەزاجێکی گاڵتەجاڕ و دڵخۆشدا بوو.

meaning: گاڵتەجاڕ، کەسێک کە حەزی لە نکتە و گاڵتەیە
definition: Fond of or characterized by joking; humorous or playful.
definitionEnglish: fond of or characterized by joking; humorous or playful.

definition: Cheerful and lighthearted.
definitionEnglish: cheerful and lighthearted.

definition: Lively and cheerful activity or celebration.
definitionEnglish: lively and cheerful activity or celebration.
exampleEnglish: The room was full of laughter and jollity.
exampleKurdish: ژوورەکە پڕ بوو لە پێکەنین و خۆشی.

meaning: پاڵنان و بەریەککەوتن لە ناو قەرەباڵغیدا
definition: Push, elbow, or bump against (someone) roughly, typically in a crowd.
definitionEnglish: push, elbow, or bump against (someone) roughly, typically in a crowd.
exampleEnglish: People were jostling each other to get a better view.

definitionEnglish: involving or requiring strenuous effort; difficult and tiring.

definitionEnglish: the jargon or slang of a particular group or class.

definitionEnglish: a long accompanied song for a solo voice, typically one in an opera or oratorio.

definition: An impressive display or range of a particular type of thing.
definitionEnglish: an impressive display or range of a particular type of thing.

definition: Money that is owed and should have been paid earlier.

definition: Having a strong, regular, repeated pattern of movement or sound.
definitionEnglish: having a strong, regular, repeated pattern of movement or sound.

meaning: لوتبەرزی، خۆبەگەورەزانین و بێڕێزی بەرامبەر خەڵک
definition: The quality of being arrogant.

definitionEnglish: a collection of weapons and military equipment stored by a country, person, or group.

definitionEnglish: (of a person or a person's words) having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently.

definitionEnglish: an object made by a human being, typically one of cultural or historical interest.

meaning: فێڵ، بەکارهێنانی زیرەکی بۆ هەڵخەڵەتاندنی خەڵک
definition: Clever or cunning devices or expedients, especially as used to trick or deceive others.
definitionEnglish: clever or cunning devices or expedients, especially as used to trick or deceive others.

meaning: سادە و ساکار، بێ فێڵ و تەڵەکەبازی

definition: Find (something) out for certain; make sure of.
definitionEnglish: find (something) out for certain; make sure of.

definitionEnglish: characterized by or suggesting the practice of severe self-discipline and abstention from all forms of indulgence, typically for religious reasons.

definitionEnglish: (of a person's face) very pale with shock, fear, or illness.

definitionEnglish: not in a straight or level position.

definitionEnglish: a person who has ambitions to achieve something, typically a particular career or status.

definitionEnglish: an official inspection of an individual's or organization's accounts, typically by an independent body.

definitionEnglish: a circle of light or brightness surrounding something, especially as depicted in art around the head or body of a holy person.

definitionEnglish: sternness or severity of manner or attitude; extreme plainness and simplicity of style or appearance; difficult economic conditions created by government measures to reduce a budget deficit.

definitionEnglish: extreme greed for wealth or material gain.

definitionEnglish: state or assert to be the case.
exampleEnglish: He averred that he was innocent.
exampleKurdish: ئەو جەختی کردەوە (بە دڵنیاییەوە وتی) کە بێتاوانە.

meaning: نەیار، کەسێک کە حەزی لە شتێک نییە و دژیەتی
definition: Having a strong dislike of or opposition to something.
definitionEnglish: having a strong dislike of or opposition to something.
exampleEnglish: He is not averse to hard work.
exampleKurdish: ئەو نەیاری کاری سەخت نییە (حەزی لێیەتی).

definition: A strong dislike or disinclination.
definitionEnglish: a strong dislike or disinclination.

meaning: دوورخستنەوە، ڕێگریکردن لە ڕوودانی شتێکی ناخۆش
definition: Prevent or ward off (an undesirable occurrence).
definitionEnglish: prevent or ward off (an undesirable occurrence).

meaning: قەفەسی باڵندە، شوێنێکی گەورە بۆ بەخێوکردنی باڵندە
definition: A large cage, building, or enclosure for keeping birds in.
definitionEnglish: a large cage, building, or enclosure for keeping birds in.
exampleEnglish: The zoo has a large aviary.
exampleKurdish: باخچەی ئاژەڵان قەفەسێکی گەورەی باڵندەی هەیە.

meaning: پەرۆش، کەسێک کە زۆر حەزی لە شتێکە و بە جۆشەوە دەیکات
definition: Having or showing a keen interest in or enthusiasm for something.
definitionEnglish: having or showing a keen interest in or enthusiasm for something.

meaning: خولیای لاوەکی، کارێک کە بۆ خۆشی دەیکەیت نەک وەک پیشە
definition: A hobby or minor occupation.
definitionEnglish: a hobby or minor occupation.

definition: Assert or confess openly.
definitionEnglish: assert or confess openly.
exampleEnglish: He avowed his love for her.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بە ئاشکرا دانی بە خۆشەویستییەکەیدا نا بۆ ئەو.

meaning: وەک مام یان خاڵ، نیشاندانی میهرەبانی و دڵسۆزی بەرامبەر گەنجتر لە خۆت
definition: Relating to an uncle; kind and friendly toward a younger person.
definitionEnglish: relating to an uncle; kind and friendly toward a younger person.

meaning: سەرسامی و ڕێز، هەستێک کە تێکەڵەیەکە لە سەرسوڕمان و ترس و ڕێز
definition: A feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder.
definitionEnglish: a feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder.
exampleEnglish: They stared in awe at the mountain.
exampleKurdish: ئەوان بە سەرسامییەوە سەیری چیاکەیان دەکرد.

meaning: خوار، هەڵە، شتێک کە بەو شێوەیە نەڕۆیشت کە پلان کرابوو
definition: Away from the appropriate, planned, or expected course; amiss.
definitionEnglish: away from the appropriate, planned, or expected course; amiss.
exampleKurdish: پلانەکانمان بە هەڵەدا چوون (بەو شێوەیە نەبوون کە دەمانویست).

meaning: بەڵگەنەویست، ڕاستییەک کە هێندە ئاشکرایە پێویستی بە سەلماندن نییە
definition: A statement or proposition that is regarded as being established, accepted, or self-evidently true.
definitionEnglish: a statement or proposition that is regarded as being established, accepted, or self-evidently true.
exampleEnglish: It is an axiom that the customer is always right.
exampleKurdish: ئەوە بەڵگەنەویستە کە کڕیار هەمیشە لەسەر هەقە.

definition: Bright blue in color, like a cloudless sky.
definitionEnglish: bright blue in color, like a cloudless sky.

meaning: بڵەبڵ، قسەکردنی خێرا و بێ مانا
definition: Talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way.
definitionEnglish: talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way.

meaning: سەرخۆشانە، ئاهەنگێکی پڕ لە مەیخواردنەوە و بێسەروبەری
definition: Characterized by or given to drunken revelry; riotously drunken.
definitionEnglish: characterized by or given to drunken revelry; riotously drunken.

meaning: بێزارکردن، داواکردنی شتێک لە کەسێک بە بەردەوامی تا ڕازی دەبێت
definition: Ask (someone) repeatedly and annoyingly for something; pester.
definitionEnglish: ask (someone) repeatedly and annoyingly for something; pester.
exampleEnglish: She badgered him into going to the party.
exampleKurdish: ئەو هێندە بێزاری کرد تا ڕازی بوو بچێت بۆ ئاهەنگەکە.

meaning: گاڵتەوگەپ، گفتوگۆیەکی سووک و خۆش بۆ پێکەنین
definition: Humorous or witty conversation.
definitionEnglish: humorous or witty conversation.
exampleEnglish: The badinage between the two friends.

meaning: سەرسامکردن، وای لێ بکەیت کەسێک بە تەواوی تێنەگات و سەری لێ بشێوێت
definition: Totally bewilder or perplex.
definitionEnglish: totally bewilder or perplex.

definition: Deliberately annoy or taunt (someone).
definitionEnglish: deliberately annoy or taunt (someone).

definition: Threatening harm; menacing.
definitionEnglish: threatening harm; menacing.

meaning: ڕەتکردنەوە، ئامادەنەبوون بۆ کردنی کارێک بەهۆی ترس یان ناڕەزایی
definition: Hesitate or be unwilling to accept an idea or undertaking.
definitionEnglish: hesitate or be unwilling to accept an idea or undertaking.
exampleEnglish: He balked at the high price.
exampleKurdish: ئەو لەبەر گرانیی نرخەکە ڕەتیکردەوە (دوودڵ بوو).

meaning: قورسایی، شتێکی قورس کە دەخرێتە ناو کەشتی بۆ جێگیرکردنی
definition: Heavy material, such as gravel, sand, iron, or lead, placed low in a vessel to improve its stability.
definitionEnglish: heavy material, such as gravel, sand, iron, or lead, placed low in a vessel to improve its stability.

meaning: مەرهەم، شتێک کە ئازار کەم دەکاتەوە و هێوری دەکاتەوە
definition: A fragrant ointment or preparation used to heal or soothe the skin; something that has a comforting or soothing effect.
definitionEnglish: a fragrant ointment or preparation used to heal or soothe the skin; something that has a comforting or soothing effect.
exampleEnglish: Music is a balm for the soul.

definition: (Of the weather) pleasantly warm.
definitionEnglish: (of the weather) pleasantly warm.

meaning: بێ مانا، شتێکی زۆر ئاسایی و دووبارە کە هیچ سەرنجڕاکێشییەکی تێدا نییە
definition: So lacking in originality as to be obvious and boring.
definitionEnglish: so lacking in originality as to be obvious and boring.
exampleKurdish: گۆرانییە پۆپە بێ مانا و دووبارەبووەکان.

meaning: ئاڵوگۆڕکردنی قسە، وتنی قسە بەملا و بەولادا
definition: Pass on or discuss (an idea or rumor) in a casual or uninformed way.
definitionEnglish: pass on or discuss (an idea or rumor) in a casual or uninformed way.
exampleKurdish: ناوی ئەو بەملا و بەولادا دەوترا (دەنگۆی لەسەر بوو).

meaning: بەڵا، هۆکاری سەرەکیی ناڕەحەتی و کێشە
definition: A cause of great distress or annoyance.
definitionEnglish: a cause of great distress or annoyance.
exampleEnglish: Mobile phones are the bane of my existence.

meaning: گاڵتەوگەپ، قسەکردن بە شێوەیەکی خۆش و گاڵتەئامێز
definition: Talk or exchange remarks in a good-humored teasing way.
definitionEnglish: talk or exchange remarks in a good-humored teasing way.

meaning: قسەی توند، سەرنجێکی تیژ و ئازاردەر
definition: A sharp projection near the end of an arrow, fishhook, or similar object, which is angled away from the main point so as to make extraction difficult; a deliberate insulting or cutting remark.
definitionEnglish: a sharp projection near the end of an arrow, fishhook, or similar object, which is angled away from the main point so as to make extraction difficult; a deliberate insulting or cutting remark.
exampleKurdish: قسە توند و ئازاردەرەکانی ناو وتارەکەی.

meaning: شاعیر، بە تایبەت شاعیرێکی کۆن و بەناوبانگ
definition: A poet, traditionally one reciting epics and associated with a particular oral tradition.
definitionEnglish: a poet, traditionally one reciting epics and associated with a particular oral tradition.
exampleEnglish: Shakespeare is known as the Bard.

meaning: بێشەرم، شتێکی خراپ کە بە بێ شەرم و بە ئاشکرا دەکرێت
definition: Shameless and undisguised.
definitionEnglish: shameless and undisguised.

meaning: بارۆک، شێوازێکی هونەریی پڕ لە ڕازاندنەوە و وردەکاریی زۆر
definition: Relating to or denoting a style of European architecture, music, and art of the 17th and 18th centuries that followed mannerism and is characterized by ornate detail.
definitionEnglish: relating to or denoting a style of European architecture, music, and art of the 17th and 18th centuries that followed mannerism and is characterized by ornate detail.

meaning: تەقەی بەردەوام، بڕێکی زۆر لە شتێک کە لە یەک کاتدا ڕوودەدات (وەک پرسیار)
definition: A concentrated outpouring, as of questions or blows.
definitionEnglish: a concentrated outpouring, as of questions or blows.

meaning: پارێزەری باڵا، پارێزەرێک کە مافی قسەکردنی لە دادگا باڵاکاندا هەیە
definition: A lawyer entitled to practice as an advocate, particularly in the higher courts.
definitionEnglish: a lawyer entitled to practice as an advocate, particularly in the higher courts.

meaning: ئاڵوگۆڕکەر، کەسێک کە شت بە شت دەگۆڕێتەوە نەک بە پارە
definition: A person who exchanges goods or services for other goods or services without using money.
definitionEnglish: a person who exchanges goods or services for other goods or services without using money.

meaning: خۆدانە بەر خۆر، چێژوەرگرتن لە گەرمی یان سەرکەوتن
definition: Lie exposed to warmth and light, typically from the sun, for relaxation and pleasure.
definitionEnglish: lie exposed to warmth and light, typically from the sun, for relaxation and pleasure.
exampleKurdish: بۆ خۆدانە بەر خۆر (چێژوەرگرتن لە خۆر).

meaning: قەڵا، شوێنێک یان بیرۆکەیەک کە بە توندی بەرگری لێ دەکرێت
definition: An institution, place, or person strongly defending or upholding particular principles, attitudes, or activities.
definitionEnglish: an institution, place, or person strongly defending or upholding particular principles, attitudes, or activities.

meaning: کەمکردنەوەی هێز، ڕاگرتنی هەناسە لەبەر پەرۆشی
definition: Restrain or moderate (the force or intensity of something).
definitionEnglish: restrain or moderate (the force or intensity of something).

meaning: شتێکی بێ بایەخ، خشڵێکی هەرزان کە تەنها بۆ جوانییە
definition: A small, showy trinket or decoration.
definitionEnglish: a small, showy trinket or decoration.

meaning: قسەی سێکسیی گاڵتەئامێز، شتێک کە کەمێک بێ ئەخلاقانەیە بەڵام بۆ پێکەنینە
definition: Dealing with sexual matters in a comical way; humorously indecent.
definitionEnglish: dealing with sexual matters in a comical way; humorously indecent.

meaning: بەختەوەرانە، نیشاندانی دڵخۆشی و ئارامییەکی زۆر
definition: Blissfully happy.
definitionEnglish: blissfully happy.
exampleKurdish: زەردەخەنەیەکی پڕ لە بەختەوەری و ئارامی.

meaning: بەختەوەریی باڵا، هەستی پیرۆزی و دڵخۆشیی زۆر
definition: Supreme blessedness.
definitionEnglish: supreme blessedness.

meaning: ڕازاندنەوەی زۆر و ناشرین، پۆشینی جلی زۆر بریقەدار
definition: Dress up or decorate gaudily.
definitionEnglish: dress up or decorate gaudily.
exampleKurdish: ڕازێنراوەتەوە بە خشڵی هەرزان و بریقەدار.

meaning: شڕ و شیت، تەڕبوون و پیسبوون بە قوڕ
definition: Dirty and disheveled.
definitionEnglish: dirty and disheveled.
exampleKurdish: جلوبەرگی شڕ و پیسبوو بە قوڕ.

meaning: سەرلێشێواندن، وای لێ بکەیت کەسێک نەتوانێت بە ڕوونی بیر بکاتەوە
definition: Make (someone) unable to think clearly.
definitionEnglish: make (someone) unable to think clearly.

definition: (Especially of a male parent) create (an offspring); give rise to; bring about.
definitionEnglish: (especially of a male parent) create (an offspring); give rise to; bring about.

meaning: بەخیلی بردن، حەزنەکردن بەوەی کەسێک شتێکی هەبێت
definition: Envy (someone) the possession or enjoyment of (something).
definitionEnglish: envy (someone) the possession or enjoyment of (something).
exampleKurdish: ئەو بەخیلیی بە سەرکەوتنەکەی ئەو دەبرد.

meaning: هەڵخەڵەتاندن بە جوانی یان بە قسەی خۆش
definition: Charm or enchant (someone), sometimes in a deceptive way.
definitionEnglish: charm or enchant (someone), sometimes in a deceptive way.
exampleEnglish: He was beguiled by her beauty.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بە جوانییەکەی ئەو هەڵخەڵەتا (سەرسام بوو).

meaning: دێوەزمە، شتێکی زۆر گەورە و بەهێز
definition: A huge or monstrous creature; something enormous, especially a big and powerful organization.
definitionEnglish: a huge or monstrous creature; something enormous, especially a big and powerful organization.

meaning: قەرزبار، هەستکردن بەوەی دەبێت سوپاسگوزاری کەسێک بیت لەبەر یارمەتییەک
definition: Owing thanks or having a duty to someone in return for help or a service.
definitionEnglish: owing thanks or having a duty to someone in return for help or a service.
exampleEnglish: I don't want to be beholden to anyone.

meaning: پێویست بوون، شایستە بوون بۆ کەسێک کە کارێک بکات
definition: It is a duty or responsibility for someone to do something; it is incumbent on.
definitionEnglish: it is a duty or responsibility for someone to do something; it is incumbent on.

meaning: دووبارەکردنەوەی زۆر، قسەکردن لەسەر شتێک زیاتر لەوەی پێویستە
definition: Argue or elaborate (a subject) in excessive detail.
definitionEnglish: argue or elaborate (a subject) in excessive detail.
exampleEnglish: There is no need to belabor the point.
exampleKurdish: پێویست ناکات خاڵەکە زۆر دووبارە بکەیتەوە.

meaning: دواکەوتوو، شتێک کە درەنگتر لە کاتی خۆی ڕوو دەدات
definition: Coming or happening later than should have been the case.
definitionEnglish: coming or happening later than should have been the case.

meaning: دەورەدان، خستنە ژێر گوشار و کێشەی زۆرەوە
definition: Lay siege to; beset with difficulties.
definitionEnglish: lay siege to; beset with difficulties.

meaning: نیشاندانی پێچەوانە، شاردنەوەی ڕاستییەک بە دەرکەوتنێکی جیاواز
definition: (Of an appearance) fail to give a true notion or impression of (something); disguise or contradict.
definitionEnglish: (of an appearance) fail to give a true notion or impression of (something); disguise or contradict.
exampleEnglish: His calm face belied his terror.
exampleKurdish: دەموچاوە ئارامەکەی، ترسەکەی ناخی دەشارایەوە (پێچەوانەکەی نیشان دەدا).

meaning: بچووککردنەوە، کەمکردنەوەی بایەخی کەسێک یان شتێک
definition: Make (someone or something) seem unimportant.
definitionEnglish: make (someone or something) seem unimportant.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بایەخی دەستکەوتەکانی ئەوی کەم کردەوە (بچووک کردەوە).

meaning: شەڕخواز، کەسێک کە حەزی لە شەڕ و کێشەیە
definition: Demonstrating aggression and willingness to fight.
definitionEnglish: demonstrating aggression and willingness to fight.

meaning: شەڕکەر، کەسێک کە زۆر توڕەیە و ئامادەیە بۆ شەڕ
definition: Hostile and aggressive.
definitionEnglish: hostile and aggressive.

meaning: ناڵاندن، دەربڕینی خەم و ناڕەزایی بۆ شتێک
definition: Express discontent or sorrow over (something).
definitionEnglish: express discontent or sorrow over (something).
exampleEnglish: He bemoaned the loss of his job.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بۆ لەدەستدانی کارەکەی دەیناڵاند (خەمی دەخوارد).

meaning: سەرلێشێواو، کەسێک کە سەری سوڕماوە و کەمێک تێکچووە
definition: Puzzled, confused, or bewildered.
definitionEnglish: puzzled, confused, or bewildered.

meaning: دوعای خێر، وتنی هیوای باش بۆ کەسێک لە کۆتایی ڕێوڕەسمێکدا
definition: The utterance or bestowing of a blessing, especially at the end of a religious service.
definitionEnglish: the utterance or bestowing of a blessing, especially at the end of a religious service.

meaning: چاکەکار، کەسێک کە یارمەتیی دارایی دەدات بە کەسێک یان ڕێکخراوێک
definition: A person who gives money or other help to a person or cause.
definitionEnglish: a person who gives money or other help to a person or cause.

meaning: خێرخواز، نیشاندانی میهرەبانی و کردنی کاری باش
definition: (Of a person) generous or doing good.
definitionEnglish: (of a person) generous or doing good.

meaning: سوودمەند، کەسێک کە سوود لە شتێک وەردەگرێت (وەک میرات یان بیمە)
definition: A person who derives advantage from something, especially a trust, will, or life insurance policy.
definitionEnglish: a person who derives advantage from something, especially a trust, will, or life insurance policy.
exampleEnglish: The main beneficiary of the will.

meaning: میهرەبان، کەسێک کە حەزی لە یارمەتیدانی خەڵکە
definition: Well meaning and kindly.
definitionEnglish: well meaning and kindly.

meaning: بێ زیان، میهرەبان، (بۆ نەخۆشی) شێرپەنجەیی نییە
definition: Gentle and kindly; (of a disease) not harmful in effect.
definitionEnglish: gentle and kindly; (of a disease) not harmful in effect.

definition: A blessing.
definitionEnglish: a blessing.

definition: A natural talent or inclination.
definitionEnglish: a natural talent or inclination.

meaning: بەجێهێشتن وەک میرات، پێدانی شتێک بە کەسێک دوای مردن
definition: Leave (a personal estate or one's body) to a person or other beneficiary by a will.
definitionEnglish: leave (a personal estate or one's body) to a person or other beneficiary by a will.
exampleEnglish: He bequeathed his fortune to his children.
exampleKurdish: ئەو سامانەکەی وەک میرات بۆ منداڵەکانی بەجێهێشت.

meaning: سەرزەنشتکردن، توڕەبوون لە کەسێک بە توندی
definition: Scold or criticize (someone) angrily.
definitionEnglish: scold or criticize (someone) angrily.
exampleEnglish: She berated him for being late.
exampleKurdish: ئەو سەرزەنشتی کرد لەبەر ئەوەی دواکەوتبوو.

meaning: خەمی مردنی کەسێکی نزیک، بارودۆخی لەدەستدانی ئازیزان
definition: The action or condition of being bereaved.
definitionEnglish: the action or condition of being bereaved.

meaning: بێبەش، هەستکردن بە تەنیایی و خەمباری بەهۆی لەدەستدانی شتێک
definition: Deprived of or lacking something; lonely and abandoned through someone's death or departure.
definitionEnglish: deprived of or lacking something; lonely and abandoned through someone's death or departure.

meaning: شێتگیر، زۆر توڕە و بێ کۆنتڕۆڵ
definition: Out of control with anger or excitement; wild or frenzied.
definitionEnglish: out of control with anger or excitement; wild or frenzied.
exampleEnglish: He went berserk when he heard the news.
exampleKurdish: ئەو شێتگیر بوو کاتێک هەواڵەکەی بیست.

meaning: پاڕانەوە، داواکردنی شتێک لە کەسێک بە پەرۆشییەوە
definition: Ask (someone) urgently and fervently to do something; implore; entreat.
definitionEnglish: ask (someone) urgently and fervently to do something; implore; entreat.

meaning: دەورەدراو بە کێشە، تووشبوون بە ناڕەحەتیی زۆر
definition: (Of a problem or difficulty) trouble or threaten persistently.
definitionEnglish: (of a problem or difficulty) trouble or threaten persistently.
exampleKurdish: پڕۆژەیەک کە بە کێشە دەورە دراوە (تووشی کێشە بووە).

meaning: دەورەدان، هێرشکردنی زۆر بۆ سەر کەسێک (بە پرسیار یان داواکاری)
definition: Surround (a place) with armed forces in order to capture it or force its surrender; crowd around (someone) oppressively.
definitionEnglish: surround (a place) with armed forces in order to capture it or force its surrender; crowd around (someone) oppressively.
exampleKurdish: ئەو لەلایەن پەیامنێرانەوە دەورە درابوو (پەستانی خرایە سەر).

definition: Damage the reputation of (someone or something) in the opinion of others.
definitionEnglish: damage the reputation of (someone or something) in the opinion of others.

definition: Of or like an animal or animals; savagely cruel and depraved.
definitionEnglish: of or like an animal or animals; savagely cruel and depraved.

meaning: نیشانە بوون، نیشاندانی شتێک کە ڕوو دەدات
definition: Be a sign of; indicate.
definitionEnglish: be a sign of; indicate.
exampleEnglish: She smiled, which betokened her consent.
exampleKurdish: ئەو زەردەخەنەی کرد، کە نیشانەی ڕەزامەندییەکەی بوو.

meaning: خیانەتکردن، ئاشکراکردنی نهێنی یان بێوەفایی بەرامبەر کەسێک
definition: Expose (one's country, a group, or a person) to danger by treacherously giving information to an enemy; be disloyal to.
definitionEnglish: expose (one's country, a group, or a person) to danger by treacherously giving information to an enemy; be disloyal to.

definition: Enter into a formal agreement to marry.
definitionEnglish: enter into a formal agreement to marry.
exampleEnglish: They were betrothed in their early twenties.
exampleKurdish: ئەوان لە سەرەتای بیستەکانی تەمەنیاندا مارەبڕان (بەڵێنی هاوسەرگیرییان دا).

meaning: کۆمەڵە، ژمارەیەکی زۆر لە شتێک یان کەسێک (بە تایبەت کچان یان باڵندە)
definition: A large group of people or things of a particular kind.
definitionEnglish: a large group of people or things of a particular kind.

meaning: شیوەنکردن، دەربڕینی خەمێکی زۆر بۆ شتێک
definition: Express great regret, disappointment, or bitterness over (something).
definitionEnglish: express great regret, disappointment, or bitterness over (something).
exampleKurdish: ئەو بۆ چارەنووسی خۆی دەیناڵاند (شیوەنی دەکرد).

meaning: سەرسامکردن، وای لێ بکەیت کەسێک بە تەواوی سەری لێ بشێوێت
definition: Cause (someone) to become perplexed and confused.
definitionEnglish: cause (someone) to become perplexed and confused.

meaning: جادوو لێکردن، سەرسامکردنی کەسێک بە شێوەیەکی زۆر
definition: Cast a spell on and gain control over (someone) by magic; enchant and delight (someone) or attract them as if by magic.
definitionEnglish: cast a spell on and gain control over (someone) by magic; enchant and delight (someone) or attract them as if by magic.
exampleEnglish: She was bewitched by his charm.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بە جوانی و سەرنجڕاکێشیی ئەو جادوو لێکرا (سەرسام بوو).

meaning: لایەنگری، هەبوونی بیروبۆچوونێکی پێشوەختە بۆ یان دژی شتێک
definition: Prejudice in favor of or against one thing, person, or group compared with another, usually in a way considered to be unfair.
definitionEnglish: prejudice in favor of or against one thing, person, or group compared with another, usually in a way considered to be unfair.

meaning: کتێب دۆست، کەسێک کە زۆر حەزی لە کتێبە و کۆیان دەکاتەوە
definition: A person who collects or has a great love of books.
definitionEnglish: a person who collects or has a great love of books.

meaning: مەیخۆر، کەسێک کە زۆر حەزی لە خواردنەوەی مەی هەیە
definition: Excessively fond of drinking alcohol.
definitionEnglish: excessively fond of drinking alcohol.

meaning: دەماقە، شەڕەقسە لەسەر شتی بێ بایەخ
definition: Argue about petty and trivial matters.
definitionEnglish: argue about petty and trivial matters.
exampleKurdish: ئەوان هەمیشە دەماقەیانە (شەڕەقسەیانە لەسەر شتی بێ بایەخ).

meaning: دوو ساڵە، شتێک کە دوو ساڵ جارێک ڕوو دەدات
definition: Taking place every other year.
definitionEnglish: taking place every other year.

meaning: دوو لک، دابەشبوو بۆ دوو بەش
definition: Divided into two branches or forks.
definitionEnglish: divided into two branches or forks.
exampleKurdish: ڕێگایەکی دوو لک (دابەشبوو بۆ دوو بەش).

meaning: دەمارگیر، کەسێک کە بڕوای بە بیروڕای خۆی هەیە و ڕقی لەوانەیە کە جیاوازن
definition: A person who is obstinately or unreasonably attached to a belief, opinion, or faction, in particular one who is prejudiced against or antagonistic toward a person or people on the basis of their membership of a particular group.
definitionEnglish: a person who is obstinately or unreasonably attached to a belief, opinion, or faction, in particular one who is prejudiced against or antagonistic toward a person or people on the basis of their membership of a particular group.

meaning: دەمارگیری، ڕق و کینە بەرامبەر کەسانی جیاواز
definition: Obstinate or unreasonable attachment to a belief, opinion, or faction; in particular, prejudice against a person or people on the basis of their membership of a particular group.
definitionEnglish: obstinate or unreasonable attachment to a belief, opinion, or faction; in particular, prejudice against a person or people on the basis of their membership of a particular group.

meaning: توڕە، کەسێک کە زوو هەڵدەچێت، یان هەستکردن بە دڵتێکچوون
definition: Spiteful; bad-tempered; affected by or associated with nausea or vomiting.
definitionEnglish: spiteful; bad-tempered; affected by or associated with nausea or vomiting.

meaning: فێڵ لێکردن، وەرگرتنی پارە لە کەسێک بە فێڵ
definition: Obtain or withhold money from (someone) by deceit or without justification; cheat or defraud.
definitionEnglish: obtain or withhold money from (someone) by deceit or without justification; cheat or defraud.
exampleEnglish: He bilked the government out of millions.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بە فێڵ ملیۆنان دۆلاری لە حکومەت برد.

meaning: شەپۆل، هەڵچوونی دووکەڵ یان قوماش بەهۆی باوە
definition: A large undulating mass of something, typically cloud, smoke, or steam; (of fabric) fill with air and swell outward.
definitionEnglish: a large undulating mass of something, typically cloud, smoke, or steam; (of fabric) fill with air and swell outward.
exampleKurdish: دووکەڵ بە شەپۆل لە سۆبەکەوە دەهاتە دەرەوە.

meaning: کەمپی کاتی، مانەوە لە دەرەوە بێ قەڵغان یان خێمە (بۆ سەربازان)
definition: A temporary camp without tents or cover, used especially by soldiers or mountaineers.
definitionEnglish: a temporary camp without tents or cover, used especially by soldiers or mountaineers.
exampleEnglish: The soldiers set up a bivouac.

meaning: سەیر و سەمەرە، شتێک کە زۆر نامۆ و جیاوازە
definition: Very strange or unusual, especially so as to cause interest or amusement.
definitionEnglish: very strange or unusual, especially so as to cause interest or amusement.

meaning: سپی هەڵگەڕان، ڕەنگپەڕین لەبەر ترس یان شۆک
definition: Make white or pale by extracting color; (of a person) grow pale from shock, fear, or a similar emotion.
definitionEnglish: make white or pale by extracting color; (of a person) grow pale from shock, fear, or a similar emotion.
exampleEnglish: He blanched at the sight of the blood.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بە بینینی خوێنەکە ڕەنگی پەڕی (سپی هەڵگەڕا).

meaning: بێ تام، شتێک کە هیچ تام و چێژێکی تایبەتی نییە
definition: Lacking strong features or characteristics and therefore uninteresting.
definitionEnglish: lacking strong features or characteristics and therefore uninteresting.

meaning: زمانلووسی، قسەی خۆش بۆ ڕازیکردنی کەسێک بۆ کارێک
definition: A flattering or pleasing statement or action used to persuade someone gently to do something.
definitionEnglish: a flattering or pleasing statement or action used to persuade someone gently to do something.
exampleEnglish: She was immune to his blandishments.
exampleKurdish: ئەو گوێی بە زمانلووسییەکانی ئەو نەدەدا.

meaning: دەنگی بەرز و ناخۆش، وەک دەنگی زوڕنا یان ڕادیۆیەکی زۆر بەرز
definition: Make a characteristic loud, harsh sound.
definitionEnglish: make a characteristic loud, harsh sound.
exampleKurdish: مۆسیقاکە بە دەنگێکی زۆر بەرز و ناخۆش دەهات.

meaning: بێباک، کەسێک کە هێندە شتی بینیوە ئیتر هیچ شتێک سەرنجی ڕاناکێشێت
definition: Unimpressed or indifferent to something because one has experienced or seen it so often before.
definitionEnglish: unimpressed or indifferent to something because one has experienced or seen it so often before.
exampleEnglish: She was blasé about her success.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بێباک بوو (هیچ سەرنجی نەدەدا) بەرامبەر سەرکەوتنەکەی.

meaning: کفر، بێڕێزی بەرامبەر خودا یان شتە پیرۆزەکان
definition: The act or offense of speaking sacrilegiously about God or sacred things; profane talk.
definitionEnglish: the act or offense of speaking sacrilegiously about God or sacred things; profane talk.
exampleKurdish: ئەو تۆمەتبار کرا بە کفرکردن (بێڕێزی بە پیرۆزییەکان).

meaning: ئاشکرا و بێشەرمانە، شتێکی خراپ کە زۆر ڕوونە
definition: (Of bad behavior) done openly and unashamedly.
definitionEnglish: (of bad behavior) done openly and unashamedly.

meaning: تاریک و بێ ئومێد، (بۆ شوێن) سارد و چۆڵ
definition: (Of a situation or future) not hopeful or encouraging; unlikely to have a favorable outcome; (of a building or room) charmless and inhospitable; dreary.
definitionEnglish: (of a situation or future) not hopeful or encouraging; unlikely to have a favorable outcome; (of a building or room) charmless and inhospitable; dreary.

meaning: تێکدان، شتێک کە زیان بە شتێکی تر دەگەیەنێت یان دەیکوژێت
definition: A thing that spoils or damages something; have a severely detrimental effect on.
definitionEnglish: a thing that spoils or damages something; have a severely detrimental effect on.
exampleKurdish: ئابڕووچوونەکە کاروانی پیشەیی ئەوی تێکدا (زیانی پێگەیاند).

definition: Perfect happiness; great joy.
definitionEnglish: perfect happiness; great joy.

definition: Showing a casual and cheerful indifference considered to be callous or improper.
definitionEnglish: showing a casual and cheerful indifference considered to be callous or improper.
exampleEnglish: A blithe disregard for the rules.

meaning: ئاوساو، پڕ لە هەوا یان شلە
definition: Swollen with fluid or gas.
definitionEnglish: swollen with fluid or gas.

meaning: لێدان بە دارێکی قورس، ناچارکردنی کەسێک بە گوشار
definition: A thick stick with a heavy end, used as a weapon; force or bully (someone) into doing something.
definitionEnglish: a thick stick with a heavy end, used as a weapon; force or bully (someone) into doing something.
exampleEnglish: They bludgeoned him into signing the contract.
exampleKurdish: ئەوان بە گوشار (زۆر) ناچاریان کرد گرێبەستەکە واژۆ بکات.

meaning: هەڵخەڵەتاندن بە نیشاندانی هێزێک کە نیتە، قسەی زل
definition: An attempt to deceive someone into believing that one can or will do something.
definitionEnglish: an attempt to deceive someone into believing that one can or will do something.
exampleKurdish: ئەو تەنها قسەی زلی دەکرد (دەیویست هەڵبخەڵەتێنێت).

meaning: هەڵەی گەورە، هەڵەیەک کە بەهۆی بێ ئاگاییەوە دەکرێت
definition: A stupid or careless mistake.
definitionEnglish: a stupid or careless mistake.

meaning: درکاندن، وتنی شتێک بە بێ بیرکردنەوە و لەناکاو
definition: Say (something) suddenly and without careful consideration.
definitionEnglish: say (something) suddenly and without careful consideration.

meaning: هەڕەشەی بێ مانا، قسەکردن بە دەنگی بەرز بەڵام بێ هێز
definition: Talk in a loud, aggressive, or indignant way with little effect.
definitionEnglish: talk in a loud, aggressive, or indignant way with little effect.
exampleKurdish: ئەو پڕ بوو لە هەڕەشەی بێ مانا.

meaning: نیشانە بوون بۆ داهاتوو، پێشبینیکردنی باش یان خراپ
definition: Be an omen of a particular outcome.
definitionEnglish: be an omen of a particular outcome.
exampleEnglish: This does not bode well for the future.
exampleKurdish: ئەمە نیشانەیەکی باش نییە بۆ داهاتوو.

definition: Not genuine or true; fake.
definitionEnglish: not genuine or true; fake.

meaning: بۆهیمی، کەسێک کە شێوازێکی ژیانی نائاسایی هەیە (زۆرجار هونەرمەندان)
definition: A person (especially an artist or writer) who lives and acts free of regard for conventional rules and practices.
definitionEnglish: a person (especially an artist or writer) who lives and acts free of regard for conventional rules and practices.

meaning: پڕ لە جۆش و خرۆش و دەنگەدەنگ، کەسێکی چالاک و دەنگبەرز
definition: (Of a person, event, or behavior) noisy, energetic, and cheerful; wild or stormy.
definitionEnglish: (of a person, event, or behavior) noisy, energetic, and cheerful; wild or stormy.
exampleKurdish: جەماوەرێکی پڕ لە جۆش و دەنگەدەنگ.

definition: Support or strengthen; prop up.
definitionEnglish: support or strengthen; prop up.

meaning: قسەی زل و بێ ناوەڕۆک، بەکارهێنانی وشەی گەورە بۆ نیشاندانی گرنگی
definition: High-sounding but with little meaning; inflated.
definitionEnglish: high-sounding but with little meaning; inflated.
exampleKurdish: وتارێکی پڕ لە قسەی زل و بێ مانا.

meaning: نیعمەت، شتێک کە زۆر بەسوودە و یارمەتیدەرە
definition: A thing that is helpful or beneficial.
definitionEnglish: a thing that is helpful or beneficial.
exampleEnglish: The new highway will be a boon to the town.
exampleKurdish: ڕێگا سەرەکییە نوێیەکە دەبێتە نیعمەتێک (سوودێکی گەورە) بۆ شارۆچکەکە.

meaning: بێ ئەدەب، کەسێک کە ڕەفتاری ناشرین و زبرە
definition: Rough and bad-mannered; coarse.
definitionEnglish: rough and bad-mannered; coarse.

meaning: تێکدان، کردنی کارێک بە شێوەیەکی زۆر خراپ و بێ سەروبەر
definition: Carry out (a task) badly or carelessly.
definitionEnglish: carry out (a task) badly or carelessly.
exampleKurdish: ئەو کارەکەی تێکدا (بە خراپی ئەنجامی دا).

definition: Large in quantity; abundant.
definitionEnglish: large in quantity; abundant.

meaning: بۆرژوا، پەیوەندیدار بە چینی ناوەڕاست و حەزکردن بە شتی ماددی
definition: Characteristic of the middle class, typically with reference to its perceived materialistic values or conventional attitudes.
definitionEnglish: characteristic of the middle class, typically with reference to its perceived materialistic values or conventional attitudes.

meaning: مانگا ئاسا، کەسێک کە خاو و بێ هەستە وەک مانگا
definition: Relating to or affecting cattle; (of a person) slow-moving and dull-witted.
definitionEnglish: relating to or affecting cattle; (of a person) slow-moving and dull-witted.

meaning: لادانی بەشە نەشیاوەکان، پاککردنەوەی کتێبێک لە وشەی ناخۆش
definition: Remove material that is considered improper or offensive from (a text or account), especially with the result that the text becomes weaker or less effective.
definitionEnglish: remove material that is considered improper or offensive from (a text or account), especially with the result that the text becomes weaker or less effective.
exampleEnglish: A bowdlerized version of the play.

meaning: کەمێک سوێر، ئاوێک کە تێکەڵەیەکە لە ئاوی شیرین و ئاوی دەریا
definition: (Of water) slightly salty, as is the mixture of river water and seawater in estuaries.
definitionEnglish: (of water) slightly salty, as is the mixture of river water and seawater in estuaries.

meaning: خۆهەڵکێشانی زۆر، قسەی زل بۆ نیشاندانی ئازایەتی
definition: Boastful or arrogant behavior.
definitionEnglish: boastful or arrogant behavior.
exampleEnglish: His speech was full of braggadocio.
exampleKurdish: وتارەکەی پڕ بوو لە خۆهەڵکێشانی زۆر.

meaning: خۆهەڵکێش، کەسێک کە زۆر ستایشی خۆی دەکات
definition: A person who boasts about achievements or possessions.
definitionEnglish: a person who boasts about achievements or possessions.
exampleEnglish: He is a bit of a braggart.

meaning: هەڵوەشاندنەوە، نیشاندانی چەک یان شتێک بە هەڕەشەئامێز
definition: Wave or flourish (something, especially a weapon) as a threat or in anger or excitement.
definitionEnglish: wave or flourish (something, especially a weapon) as a threat or in anger or excitement.
exampleKurdish: ئەو چەقۆیەکی هەڵوەشاندەوە (نیشان دا بە هەڕەشەوە).

meaning: ئازایەتیی ساختە، نیشاندانی ئازایەتی بۆ هەڵخەڵەتاندنی خەڵک
definition: A bold manner or a show of boldness intended to impress or intimidate.
definitionEnglish: a bold manner or a show of boldness intended to impress or intimidate.
exampleEnglish: It was an act of pure bravado.
exampleKurdish: ئەوە تەنها نیشاندانی ئازایەتییەکی ساختە بوو.

definition: Physical strength in contrast to intelligence.
definitionEnglish: physical strength in contrast to intelligence.
exampleEnglish: He has more brawn than brains.
exampleKurdish: ئەو هێزی جەستەیی لە ژیرییەکەی زیاترە.

meaning: بێشەرم، کەسێک کە کارێکی خراپ دەکات و شەرم ناکات
definition: Bold and without shame.
definitionEnglish: bold and without shame.

definition: An act of breaking or failing to observe a law, agreement, or code of conduct.
definitionEnglish: an act of breaking or failing to observe a law, agreement, or code of conduct.

definition: The distance or measurement from side to side of something; width; wide range or extent.
definitionEnglish: the distance or measurement from side to side of something; width; wide range or extent.

meaning: کورتی، کورت و پوختی لە قسەکردن یان نووسیندا
definition: Concise and exact use of words in writing or speech; shortness of time.
definitionEnglish: concise and exact use of words in writing or speech; shortness of time.

definition: The headgear used to control a horse; show one's resentment or anger, especially by throwing up the head and drawing in the chin.
definitionEnglish: the headgear used to control a horse; show one's resentment or anger, especially by throwing up the head and drawing in the chin.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بە پێشنیارەکەی ئەو توڕە بوو (ناڕەزایی نیشان دا).

definition: The upper edge or lip of a cup, bowl, or other container; be full to the point of overflowing.
definitionEnglish: the upper edge or lip of a cup, bowl, or other container; be full to the point of overflowing.
exampleEnglish: The cup was filled to the brim.

meaning: خەت خەت، ئاژەڵێک کە ڕەنگی قاوەیی و خەتی تاریکی تێدایە
definition: (Of a domestic animal) brownish or tawny with streaks of other color.
definitionEnglish: (of a domestic animal) brownish or tawny with streaks of other color.

meaning: خێرا و چالاک، کەشوهەوایەکی سارد و پاک
definition: Active, fast, and energetic.
definitionEnglish: active, fast, and energetic.

definition: A short stiff hair on an animal's skin or a man's face; (of hair) stand upright away from the skin, especially in anger or fear.
definitionEnglish: a short stiff hair on an animal's skin or a man's face; (of hair) stand upright away from the skin, especially in anger or fear.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بە سوکایەتییەکە توڕە بوو (مووی جەستەی ڕاست بووەوە).

definition: Hard but liable to break or shatter easily.
definitionEnglish: hard but liable to break or shatter easily.

meaning: باسکردنی بابەتێکی هەستیار بۆ یەکەم جار
definition: Raise (a sensitive or difficult subject) for discussion.
definitionEnglish: raise (a sensitive or difficult subject) for discussion.
exampleEnglish: He broached the subject of a pay rise.
exampleKurdish: ئەو بابەتی زیادکردنی مووچەی باس کرد (بۆ یەکەم جار).

meaning: قوماشی نەخشێنراو، قوماشێکی گرانبەها کە نەخشی تێدایە
definition: A rich fabric, usually silk, woven with a raised pattern, typically with gold or silver thread.
definitionEnglish: a rich fabric, usually silk, woven with a raised pattern, typically with gold or silver thread.

meaning: نامیلکە، کتێبێکی بچووک بۆ ڕیکلام یان زانیاری
definition: A small book or magazine containing pictures and information about a product or service.
definitionEnglish: a small book or magazine containing pictures and information about a product or service.

definition: Cook (meat or fish) by exposure to direct heat; a quarrel or commotion.
definitionEnglish: cook (meat or fish) by exposure to direct heat; a quarrel or commotion.

meaning: قسەی بێ مانا و دووبارە بۆ هێورکردنەوەی کەسێک
definition: A trite and unoriginal ideas or remark, typically intended to soothe or placate.
definitionEnglish: a trite and unoriginal ideas or remark, typically intended to soothe or placate.
exampleKurdish: ئەو قسە بێ مانا و دووبارەبووەکانی هەمیشەیی پێشکەش کرد.

meaning: سەرسینە، خشڵێک کە بە جلەوە دەکرێت
definition: An ornament fastened to clothing with a hinged pin and catch.
definitionEnglish: an ornament fastened to clothing with a hinged pin and catch.

meaning: ڕێگرینەکردن، قبوڵکردنی شتێک (زۆرجار بە نەرێنی بەکاردێت)
definition: A small stream; tolerate or allow (something, typically dissent or opposition).
definitionEnglish: a small stream; tolerate or allow (something, typically dissent or opposition).

definition: Intimidate (someone), typically into doing something, with stern or abusive words.
definitionEnglish: intimidate (someone), typically into doing something, with stern or abusive words.
exampleEnglish: He was browbeaten into a confession.
exampleKurdish: ئەو ترسێنرا تا دانی بە تاوانەکەدا نا.

meaning: سەیرکردنی کتێب یان شتومەک بە بێ مەبەستێکی دیاریکراو
definition: Survey goods or text in a leisurely way.
definitionEnglish: survey goods or text in a leisurely way.
exampleKurdish: بۆ سەیرکردنی ناو کتێبێک (بە بێ وردبوونەوە).

meaning: بەشی هەرە قورسی شتێک، بەرکەوتنی سەرەکیی هێرشێک
definition: The worst part or chief resistance of a specified action.
definitionEnglish: the worst part or chief resistance of a specified action.
exampleEnglish: To bear the brunt of the attack.
exampleKurdish: بۆ گرتنە ئەستۆی بەشی هەرە قورسی هێرشەکە.

meaning: زبر و کورت، قسەکردن بە شێوەیەکی کورت و بێ ئەدەبانە
definition: Abrupt or offhand in speech or manner.
definitionEnglish: abrupt or offhand in speech or manner.

definition: A pirate, originally one operating in the Caribbean.
definitionEnglish: a pirate, originally one operating in the Caribbean.

meaning: گوندنشینانە، پەیوەندیدار بە ژیانی خۆشی گوند
definition: Relating to the pleasant aspects of the countryside and country life.
definitionEnglish: relating to the pleasant aspects of the countryside and country life.

meaning: گاڵتەجاڕی، ڕەفتاری پێکەنیناوی و بێ مانا
definition: Behavior that is ridiculous but amusing.
definitionEnglish: behavior that is ridiculous but amusing.
exampleEnglish: The film is full of buffoonery.

meaning: دێوەزمەی خەیاڵی، شتێک کە خەڵک لێی دەترسن بە بێ هۆکارێکی ڕاستەقینە
definition: An object of fear or alarm; a bugbear.
definitionEnglish: an object of fear or alarm; a bugbear.

meaning: زێڕ یان زیوی خاو، بە شێوەی قاڵب
definition: Gold or silver in bulk before coining, or valued by weight.
definitionEnglish: gold or silver in bulk before coining, or valued by weight.

definition: A defensive wall; a person, institution, or principle that acts as a protection.
definitionEnglish: a defensive wall; a person, institution, or principle that acts as a protection.

meaning: خۆبەزلزان، کەسێک کە زۆر متمانەی بە خۆیەتی بە شێوەیەکی بێزارکەر
definition: Self-assertive or proud to an irritating degree.
definitionEnglish: self-assertive or proud to an irritating degree.

definition: A low house, with only one story or, in some cases, upper rooms set in the roof, typically with a wide veranda.
definitionEnglish: a low house, with only one story or, in some cases, upper rooms set in the roof, typically with a wide veranda.
exampleKurdish: ئەوان لە خانوویەکی یەک نهۆمیدا دەژین.

meaning: تێکدان، کردنی هەڵەی گەورە لە کارێکدا
